title: Quality Control Admin — Real Estate Media
description:
About Us



We are a Canadian real estate media company that produces high-end photography, video, drone footage, and floor plans for real estate agents and brokerages. Our work is fast-paced, detail-oriented, and deadline-driven — agents need their listings live quickly, and the quality of every deliverable reflects directly on our reputation.



We're a small, growing team and we take pride in producing work that stands out. We're now looking for a detail-focused admin to own our quality control process and make sure every photo gallery and floor plan that goes out the door meets our standard before it reaches the client.





The Role



You will be the last set of eyes on every deliverable before it's sent to the client. Your job is to review completed photo galleries and floor plans, flag anything that doesn't meet our quality standard, and approve deliverables for delivery — all inside our project management and delivery platforms.



This is not a creative editing role. It's a precision review role. You need a sharp eye, strong attention to detail, and the ability to follow a checklist consistently.





What You'll Do



Photo QC



Review completed real estate photo galleries in Aryeo (our delivery platform)

Check for issues including: incorrect exposure or color, visible objects that should have been removed (cords, clutter), blurry or out-of-focus images, missed shots from the required shot list, incorrect order/sequencing of photos

Log any issues clearly so the editor knows exactly what to fix and where

Approve galleries that meet standard and flag those that need revision





Floor Plan QC



Review iGuide floor plans for accuracy and presentation

Check that room labels are correct and consistently named

Check that the layout is clean, legible, and matches the property

Flag any errors or inconsistencies before delivery



Admin & Tracking



Update task statuses in ClickUp as jobs move through QC

Keep a simple log of common revision types to help identify recurring issues

Communicate revision requests to the editor clearly and professionally

Confirm re-submissions meet the standard before approving



Tools We Use





Aryeo — our delivery and gallery platform (you will review and approve/reject galleries here)

ClickUp — task and project management (you will update job statuses here)

Dropbox — file access for floor plans





We will train you on all of these tools. You do not need prior experience with them, but you do need to be comfortable learning software quickly.





What We're Looking For



Strong attention to detail — this is the most important quality for this role

Good eye for image quality (exposure, sharpness, color balance) — prior experience with real estate photo review or photo editing is a strong asset but not required

Clear, professional written English for logging revision notes

Reliable, consistent, and self-managed — you'll be working async and we need someone who follows through without being chased

Comfortable following SOPs and checklists

Stable internet connection and a dedicated workspace



Hours & Compensation



Hours: Approximately 10–20 hours per week to start, with the potential to grow as our volume increases

Schedule: Flexible, but turnaround on QC reviews must happen within a set window (usually same business day)

Pay: Competitive for this type of role — we will discuss rate based on your experience





How to Apply



Please send your application through OnlineJobs.ph with the following:





A short introduction — who you are, what you've done, and why this role interests you

Any experience you have with photo review, quality control, admin work, or real estate media

To show us you read this posting carefully, start your application with the word "Aryeo" at the top.





Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed. We are looking for someone who pays attention to detail — and that starts here.





We're excited to find the right person and build something great together.

1. Infrastructure & Compliance Setup



Configure domain and subdomain DNS records (A, CNAME, TXT, MX) to connect our existing website to GHL.



Set up proper
 authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) to ensure high deliverability and avoid spam folders.



Manage our complete A2P 10DLC Standard Brand and Campaign registration. You must ensure our legal business name matches our EIN/147c letter perfectly to guarantee approval.



2. Website Integration



Create a GHL subdomain for our landing pages and tracking links.



Build custom GHL contact forms and appointment calendars, and embed them onto our existing website platform.



Install the GHL tracking pixel on our main site to monitor lead behavior.



Ensure all website opt-in forms include the mandatory TCPA-compliant consent language, privacy policy, and terms of service links required for SMS carrier approval.



3. Workflow Automation & CRM Configuration



Build a customized CRM pipeline that reflects our actual sales process.



Create an automated "Speed to Lead" workflow that triggers instantly when a website form is submitted (e.g., Tag applied -> Pipeline stage updated -> Internal notification -> Immediate SMS/Email to the lead).



Troubleshoot and test all triggers to ensure there are no silent failures before launch.



Requirements

You must have proven, hands-on experience specifically with the technical backend of GoHighLevel (not just front-end page building).



You must have successfully navigated the A2P 10DLC registration process in 2025/2026 and understand the strict carrier requirements for opt-in compliance.



Fluent in managing DNS records across providers (e.g., Cloudflare, GoDaddy, Namecheap).



Strong English communication skills to document what you built and hand it over clearly.



How to Apply

What is the most common reason an A2P 10DLC Standard Brand registration gets rejected, and how do you prevent it?



Briefly describe the steps you take to embed a GHL form onto an external website so that it triggers a follow-up workflow.

- Strong understanding of marketplace operations, e-commerce marketing, and digital advertising.

- Experience in product listing optimisation, campaign management, and conversion rate optimisation (CRO).

- Strong knowledge of social media trends, content strategy, influencer marketing, and viral content creation.

- Experience working with micro-influencers, affiliates, ambassadors, or KOL campaigns is highly preferred.

- A proactive, self-driven, and creative mindset with the ability to take initiative, solve problems independently, and consistently generate fresh marketing ideas that drive business growth.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across different teams.

- Detail-oriented with a proactive mindset and a passion for continuous improvement.

- Experience with Google Analytics, Google Ads, TikTok Ads Manager, or similar marketing tools is an advantage.

- Experience with Amazon Seller Central is a bonus but not required.

- Experience working across multiple Southeast Asian markets is an advantage.

- You should be passionate about e-commerce, enjoy analysing data, testing new ideas, creating engaging marketing campaigns, collaborating with creative teams, and producing content that drives real business results.

We're looking for someone who is entrepreneurial, proactive, and always searching for the next opportunity to increase traffic, conversions, and revenue.

title: Google Media Buyer
description:
URGENT HIRING!!



JOB TITLE: Google Media Buyer





This is a full-time role for a Google Media Buyer. You’ll be responsible for the execution, optimization, and scaling of paid campaigns across Google Ads surfaces (Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Demand Gen). You’ll work closely with Strategists and Creators to deploy UGC-driven campaigns, manage budgets, and leverage AI-powered buying strategies.





Responsibilities:

Campaign Setup & Execution

Take full ownership of the Google Ads account

Launch, manage, and scale campaigns across Google Ads (Search, PMAX, YouTube, Demand Gen).

Maintain campaign guardrails: brand vs. non-brand search, PMax asset groups, YouTube whitelisting, and Demand Gen deployment.

Creative Deployment & Rights Management

Source, upload, and organize rights-cleared creator content (UGC, founder videos, brand assets).

Manage creator whitelisting (channel linking or URL permissions).

Deploy assets in required formats: images (1.91:1, 1:1, 4:5), vertical & long-form video, ad copy (headlines + descriptions).





Optimization & Testing

Run bi-weekly low-cost testing loops: add new assets, launch fresh asset groups, and iterate.

Apply thresholds: pause underperformers, scale winners, refresh every 30–45 days.

Monitor PMAX ad strength, feed health, and attribution accuracy.





Budget & Measurement

Ensure proper pacing of media spend while maximizing ROAS and CPA efficiency.

Apply consistent UTM frameworks for cross-channel measurement.

Use server-side integrations (Upstackified) to sync Shopify/Klaviyo/CRM data.





Data, Feeds & Signals

Maintain Merchant Center feeds (via Symprosys) and resolve disapprovals.

Set up custom segments (keywords, URLs, apps) and leverage creator-driven audiences.

Build lifecycle audiences (purchasers, cart abandoners, product viewers) for retargeting.





Collaboration & Reporting

Complete and submit weekly performance reports

Partner with Strategists and Designers to align creative and strategy.

Provide performance insights: wins, trends, and scaling opportunities.

Ensure compliance with Google Ads policies and rights agreements.





Qualifications

5+ years of hands-on experience running Google Ads campaigns in an agency or eCommerce setting.

Proven success managing PMAX, YouTube Ads, and Search campaigns for acquisition and retention.

Strong understanding of UGC-driven creative strategy and rights management.

Experience with Shopify integrations, product feed management, and data syncs.

Familiarity with attribution, UTMs, and cross-channel measurement.

Detail-oriented with strong executional discipline and ability to troubleshoot fast.

Clear communicator, able to work with Strategists, Creators, and Designers to drive performance.





Bonus:

Experience with Refunnel, Social Snowball, Upstackified, Symprosys.

Comfort running true YouTube whitelisting campaigns with creators.

Familiarity with Klaviyo, Triple Whale, or other attribution tools.





Rate: $1,000 USD

Schedule: Full-time, PST time ( 8 hours/day, Monday - Friday)

Requirement: Minimum 5 years related experience

• Communicate with business contacts such as warehouse teams, suppliers and billing.

• Monitor and moderate social media channels and delegate with customer support team

• Upload and maintain products in Shopify (titles, descriptions, collections, tags, metafields, images)

• Keep supplier communications on track: follow-ups, order confirmations, shipping updates

• Create and maintain SOPs for every recurring task (Loom videos plus written docs)

title: **Virtual CRM & Lead Management Coordinator**
description:
# Virtual CRM & Lead Management Coordinator



**William Holder Realty Team**



## Position Overview



The William Holder Realty Team is seeking a highly organized, analytical, and proactive **Virtual CRM & Lead Management Coordinator** to oversee agent lead performance, database activity, system adoption, and sales accountability.



This person will function as a virtual extension of the Team Leader and Sales Manager, helping ensure that leads are worked properly, agents are following required processes, databases remain organized, and opportunities are not being missed.



The ideal candidate is comfortable working inside multiple real estate technology platforms, analyzing agent performance, identifying gaps, and holding agents accountable through clear communication, follow-up, coaching, and lead reassignment when necessary.



This is not simply a data-entry position. The right person must be able to review performance, recognize patterns, make recommendations, and take action.



## Key Responsibilities



### CRM and Database Management



* Monitor Follow Up Boss and other lead platforms to ensure leads are being contacted and followed up with consistently.

* Identify leads and contacts that have not been touched within the required follow-up period.

* Review agent databases for missed opportunities, incomplete records, inaccurate stages, and overdue tasks.

* Identify sphere contacts that have not been contacted in more than 90 days.

* Move unworked or neglected leads into the appropriate team lead pond or “Hot Pond.”

* Reassign leads when agents are not meeting the team’s follow-up and performance expectations.

* Add detailed notes regarding agent activity, lead status, coaching recommendations, and reassignment decisions.

* Perform virtual lead follow-up when appropriate through calls, texts,
s, and CRM campaigns.

* Recommend specific follow-up strategies for agents based on the lead’s history, source, stage, and engagement.



### Agent Performance Monitoring



Conduct regular performance reviews using data from:



* Follow Up Boss

* Zillow

* Zillow Home Loans funnels

* Maverick

* Ylopo

* Fello

* Zillow Pro

* Rezen

* RedX

* Additional team systems and lead platforms



Review and report on:



* Number of leads assigned

* Lead response time

* Pickup rate

* Contact rate

* Appointment-set rate

* Appointment-met rate

* Preapproval rate

* Offer rate

* Conversion rate

* Lead source performance

* Agent production

* Commission splits

* Overall sales performance

* Database engagement

* Follow-up consistency

* Zillow Home Loans usage and funnel activity



Provide agents and leadership with actionable feedback based on the data.



### Zillow Lead Management



Manage and monitor the team’s Zillow Sales Manager lists.



Review agents who:



* Have more than 50 active Zillow leads.

* Are ranked Fair or Low.

* Have a pickup rate below 25%.

* Have fewer than 20% of met clients preapproved.

* Have an appointment-met rate below 55%.

* Are not consistently updating lead statuses.

* Are failing to follow the required Zillow lead process.



Responsibilities include:



* Pausing agents from receiving new opportunities when appropriate.

* Nudging agents regarding overdue follow-up.

* Reassigning neglected or unworked leads.

* Reviewing Zillow ZIP-code coverage and agent availability.

* Monitoring Zillow lead routing and distribution.

* Reviewing agent Zillow profiles for completeness and quality.

* Ensuring agents maintain updated photos, biographies, reviews, transactions, and service areas.

* Encouraging and tracking proper usage of Zillow Pro.

* Reviewing the “My Agent Opportunities” smart list.

* Monitoring Zillow Home Loans activity and preapproval funnels.

* Communicating performance concerns and required corrective actions.



### Fello Database Management



* Review Fello for missed opportunities and homeowner engagement.

* Monitor new Fello features and recommend ways the team can use them.

* Identify marketing and retargeting opportunities.

* Confirm whether Fello is properly enriching the team database.

* Review seller intent, property activity, home valuation engagement, and potential listing opportunities.

* Share relevant opportunities and updates with agents and leadership.

* Help agents develop follow-up strategies for Fello-generated opportunities.

* Track whether agents are working the opportunities provided through the platform.



### New Agent Systems Review



Ensure every agent who has been with WHRT for fewer than three months is properly onboarded and actively using all required systems.



Systems may include:



* Follow Up Boss

* Rezen

* Ylopo

* Zillow

* Zillow Pro

* Zillow Home Loans

* Maverick

* Fello

* RedX

* Open to Close

* BrokerBlocks

* Client Giant

* Team communication and training platforms



Confirm that new agents:



* Have active logins.

* Understand how each system is used.

* Have completed their profiles.

* Are receiving the correct leads.

* Are following required workflows.

* Are updating lead stages and notes.

* Are completing assigned tasks.

* Understand team lead-conversion standards.

* Know where to find training materials and support.



Escalate access issues, training gaps, and performance concerns to leadership.



### Systems and Process Accountability



* Regularly audit agents’ use of team technology and systems.

* Ensure agents are following established lead-management and sales processes.

* Review Rezen for transactions, downline activity, stock awards, and relevant agent information.

* Confirm that agent profiles and records are accurate across all platforms.

* Identify systems that are being underutilized.

* Provide agents with reminders, resources, and feedback.

* Recommend improvements to team processes and technology usage.

* Help document and update standard operating procedures.

* Track recurring problems and present solutions to leadership.

* Assist with testing and implementing new features or workflows.



### Agent Communication and Accountability



* Contact agents regarding overdue leads, untouched contacts, missing notes, and incomplete tasks.

* Provide clear, professional, and constructive feedback.

* Help agents understand where their performance is falling short.

* Recommend specific actions to improve conversion.

* Follow up to confirm that required actions were completed.

* Recognize strong performance and share positive trends with leadership.

* Maintain consistent communication with agents without allowing accountability items to disappear into the CRM abyss.

* Escalate repeated noncompliance or performance issues to the Team Leader or Sales Manager.



### Reporting



Prepare regular reports for leadership covering:



* Leads requiring reassignment

* Agents requiring coaching

* Agents who should be paused

* Untouched database contacts

* Sphere contacts overdue for follow-up

* New-agent system adoption

* Zillow performance

* Zillow Home Loans performance

* Fello opportunities

* Lead-source conversion

* Follow-up gaps

* Appointment and preapproval metrics

* Overall agent performance

* Recommended corrective actions



Reports should clearly explain what is happening, why it matters, and what action should be taken.



## Performance Expectations



The Virtual CRM & Lead Management Coordinator will be expected to:



* Reduce the number of unworked and neglected leads.

* Improve agent follow-up consistency.

* Increase CRM accuracy and database engagement.

* Improve pickup, contact, appointment, preapproval, and conversion rates.

* Ensure new agents are fully onboarded into all required systems.

* Identify missed opportunities before they are lost.

* Improve team utilization of Zillow Pro, Fello, Follow Up Boss, Maverick, Ylopo, and other platforms.

* Maintain organized documentation and detailed notes.

* Hold agents accountable in a professional and consistent manner.

* Make recommendations based on data rather than assumptions.



## Qualifications



* Experience working virtually with a real estate team, brokerage, inside sales department, or sales organization is strongly preferred.

* Experience with Follow Up Boss is highly preferred.

* Familiarity with Zillow, Zillow Pro, Ylopo, Fello, Maverick, Rezen, RedX, or similar platforms is a major advantage.

* Strong understanding of CRM management and lead-conversion processes.

* Comfortable reviewing data and identifying performance trends.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to communicate corrective feedback professionally.

* Highly organized and detail-oriented.

* Able to manage multiple systems and priorities.

* Comfortable holding salespeople accountable.

* Self-motivated and able to work independently.

* Able to protect confidential client, agent, and company information.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is someone who naturally notices when something is being missed and takes action before being asked.



They are organized, persistent, comfortable with technology, and able to balance accountability with professionalism. They do not simply report problems—they investigate them, document them, recommend a solution, and follow through.



This person should enjoy working with data, improving systems, helping agents perform at a higher level, and making sure every lead receives the attention it deserves.

title: Sales Operations
description:
Sales Operations Manager for The Business of Dance - 

Remote full time independent contractor



Compensation: $1,000 monthly base plus 0.5% of cash collected

Payment Terms: Invoices are due on the 1st of each month and paid no later than the 7th of each month

Start Date: Hiring immediately



We are looking to hire a highly organized, proactive, and detail driven Sales Operations Manager to support the day to day operations of our sales department.



We are looking to hire right away, so immediate response is greatly appreciated.



This is not a closing role. You will not be responsible for closing sales. We already have appointment setters and closers who handle the sales conversations and closing process.



This role is focused on communication, systems, tracking, reporting, accountability, and cash collection support. You will help make sure the sales department is operating smoothly behind the scenes by ensuring that leads are tracked properly, notes are updated, appointments are monitored, sales data is accurate, overdue payments are followed up on, and nothing falls through the cracks.



This is the person who helps keep the sales machine clean, organized, and running properly.



Compensation



This role pays a $1,000 monthly base plus 0.5% of cash collected.



Our business typically generates between $50,000 and $150,000 per month, so here is what compensation can look like based on cash collected:



$50,000 collected = $250 commission + $1,000 base = $1,250 total

$75,000 collected = $375 commission + $1,000 base = $1,375 total

$100,000 collected = $500 commission + $1,000 base = $1,500 total

$150,000 collected = $750 commission + $1,000 base = $1,750 total



This role is ideal for someone who is motivated by results and understands that stronger follow up, cleaner systems, and better collections directly impact compensation.



Main Purpose of the Role



The main purpose of this role is to support the sales department operationally, not to sell.

You will work alongside appointment setters and closers to make sure:



sales systems are functioning properly

leads and clients are tracked correctly

leadership has visibility into the numbers and performance of the department



Key Responsibilities



Sales Department Operations

Monitor movement through the pipeline

Ensure notes, tags, statuses, and tasks are updated accurately

Help maintain clean internal processes and accountability



Sales Data and Reporting



Track and monitor all key sales data

Maintain accurate reporting across pipeline activity, show rates, unpaid balances, cash collected, and outstanding receivables

Ensure data is current, organized, and accounted for

Provide weekly and monthly reporting to leadership

Help leadership make decisions based on real time numbers and clean data

Cash Collection and Accounts Receivable Support

Assist closers with collecting cash after the sale

Track outstanding invoices and overdue balances

Follow up with clients regarding unpaid invoices in a professional and timely manner through
, text, and phone when needed

Make periodic phone calls to customers to follow up on accounts receivable and overdue balances

Keep accurate records of payment activity and communication

Monitor payments and payment history through Stripe

Help reduce accounts receivable and improve monthly cash collection

Coordinate with leadership regarding payment plans and collection priorities



Team Communication and Accountability

Communicate clearly with appointment setters, closers, leadership, and other tea
mbers

Help hold the team accountable for updating notes, tasks, and statuses

Support strong internal communication and smooth handoff between departments

Make sure nothing important slips through the cracks



Schedule and Availability



This is a full time role of approximately 40 hours per week, typically spread across 6 days per week, averaging about 6.5 to 7 hours per day.



Working hours are flexible within our approved time window. We are open to discussing either a split shift schedule, where hours are divided into two shorter work blocks with a sleep break in between, or a continuous shift schedule, where the candidate works one consistent block of approximately 6.5 to 7 hours per day.



The exact schedule can be discussed based on what works best for both the company and the candidate, as long as the role is properly covered and responsibilities are handled consistently.

mbers

mbers

These are just sample schedule options. We are open to discussing the exact structure, whether split shift or continuous, as long as the candidate can maintain strong focus, reliability, responsiveness, and consistent coverage.



Commitment Expectations



Because this is a full time role, we are looking for someone who is fully committed and able to give this position their full focus and energy.



This role is not ideal for someone juggling multiple jobs, split priorities, or heavy outside commitments that may affect responsiveness, consistency, or performance. We are looking for someone dependable, engaged, and available to fully support the team.

This training period is important so the right candidate can properly understand how our company operates and feel confident using our tools and processes.

title: Online English/World History Teachers (Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Patient Concierge & Lead Conversion Specialist – Longevity Clinic
description:
We are hiring a warm, polished, and persuasive Patient Concierge & Lead Conversion Specialist to respond to prospective patients and book qualified consultations at our in-person medical clinics in Beverly Hills, California, and North Georgia.



This is a patient-facing sales and appointment-setting position—not a general administrative VA role. You will often be the first person a prospective patient speaks with, so you must be responsive, professional, confident, and excellent at building trust over the phone.



RESPONSIBILITIES:



- Respond to new leads within five minutes during assigned working hours

- Contact leads by phone, text, and
 using GoHighLevel (GHL)

- Learn each prospect’s goals and determine whether our services may be a good fit

- Explain our practice and services using approved information

- Qualify prospects based on our provided criteria, including their interest in self-pay care

- Address common questions and objections without providing medical advice

- Book qualified prospects for in-person consultations

- Follow up consistently with leads who are not ready to schedule immediately

- Keep accurate notes, tasks, and lead statuses in GHL

- Work closely with the head of the medical practice and the head of AdDisruption, our marketing agency



ABOUT OUR PRACTICES:



We provide proactive, preventive medical care for patients who want to improve both their healthspan and lifespan. We do not accept insurance.



You will be trained on our services, qualification criteria, patient profiles, and approved messaging. Topics may include testosterone treatment for men and women, platelet-rich plasma treatments, peptides, preventive medicine, anti-aging medicine, and longevity.



You do not need to be a medical expert. However, you must be curious, eager to learn, and comfortable discussing medical and longevity topics accurately. Familiarity with respected experts, podcasts, or trends in the longevity space is a plus.



THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:



- Has exceptional spoken and written English

- Speaks clearly and is easily understood by American patients

- Has a warm, polished phone presence appropriate for a premium medical practice

- Sounds conversational rather than scripted

- Has experience in phone sales, appointment setting, lead conversion, or patient coordination

- Is comfortable discussing pricing and qualifying prospects for self-pay services

- Can persuade and overcome objections without being aggressive

- Is dependable, organized, coachable, and consistent with follow-up

- Has experience with GHL or a similar CRM

- Has experience in medical, longevity, wellness, aesthetics, or another high-trust service business



This is a remote position representing established in-person medical clinics. You may explain services using our approved materials, but you must never diagnose, recommend treatment, promise results, or provide medical advice.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief phone role-play to demonstrate spoken communication, listening, rapport-building, objection handling, and appointment-setting ability.

title: Phone Support Executive Assistant (Property Management, No PM Experience Required)
description:

If you take pride in ownership, genuinely enjoy helping people, and want to become an indispensable part of a growing business, keep reading.



WHO YOU ARE



-You are warm, friendly, and confident on the phone.

-You know how to make people feel comfortable within the first few 
nts of a conversation.

-You enjoy talking with people and helping them move forward.

-You are reliable, proactive, and take responsibility without needing constant supervision.

-You don't sound robotic, scripted, or transactional, and you usually avoid filler words such as "um."

-Night shift experience

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF:

COMPENSATION

title: Healthcare SEO Strategist  (Mid-Level to Senior)
description:
Healthcare SEO Strategist (Mid-Level to Senior)



Direct Medical or Healthcare SEO Experience Required



Work arrangement: Long-term remote contractor Starting workload: Approximately 10–40 hours per month starting



Starting compensation: $8.14–$12.21 per hour w/ potential immediate increase (keep reading below for details)

Location: Philippines Schedule: Flexible, with negotiable Pacific Time overlap



About the Opportunity

This is not an entry-level SEO position.



MedGains is a U.S.-based, clinician-founded healthcare marketing agency. We help patient-facing and B2B healthcare organizations strengthen visibility, authority, and growth through SEO, content, local search, and emerging AI-driven discovery.



Direct, verifiable experience developing and managing SEO campaigns for healthcare, medical, health-technology, or clinically focused organizations is required.



The selected strategist will begin with responsibility for one active U.S. healthcare SEO campaign. As strong performance is demonstrated and MedGains adds new clients, additional healthcare campaigns and approved working hours may be assigned.



Our intention is to develop a long-term relationship with someone who can gradually become a central part of MedGains’ healthcare search operations.



About MedGains

Healthcare marketing should begin with understanding healthcare.



MedGains was founded by a licensed Respiratory Therapist with experience across hospitals, critical care, pediatric and adult settings, sleep medicine, and home healthcare.



While continuing his clinical career, he also invested in healthcare startups, supported their business-development efforts, and helped market their technologies to difficult-to-reach prospects including hospitals, medical practices, healthcare executives, and other key decision-makers.



That combination of clinical experience, healthcare operations, entrepreneurship, business development, and marketing strategy shapes how MedGains approaches every campaign.



We do not begin by asking only:



“What keywords should this organization rank for?”



We ask:



How does this healthcare organization actually grow?

Who is searching—patients, clinicians, administrators, referral partners, or business buyers?

What information do they need before making a decision?

What have competitors and current search results overlooked?

How can the organization become a trusted authority rather than simply another search result?



Our principle is simple:



Understanding first. Marketing second.

What You Will Own

You will help lead the strategic direction, execution planning, quality, and performance of healthcare SEO campaigns.



Your responsibilities may include:



Researching healthcare markets, services, audiences, competitors, and search behavior

Developing keyword, topic, search-intent, content, and site-architecture strategies

Building prioritized SEO roadmaps and monthly action plans

Recommending service pages, location pages, content clusters, and supporting resources

Reviewing existing pages and identifying content gaps

Creating or directing SEO content briefs and outlines

Improving on-page SEO, internal linking, metadata, and topical authority

Identifying technical issues involving crawling, indexing, site structure, duplicate content, performance, canonicals, schema, and internal links

Guiding local SEO, Google Business Profile, citations, reviews, directories, and location visibility

Identifying healthcare associations, directories, publications, partnerships, and authority-building opportunities

Monitoring Google AI experiences, answer engines, generative search, entity signals, brand mentions, and structured information

Tracking rankings, organic visibility, traffic, leads, and other meaningful outcomes

Investigating performance changes and adjusting the strategy based on evidence

Clearly communicating priorities, findings, and recommendations



Depending on campaign needs, implementation may involve writers, developers, technical SEO specialists, outreach resources, or other contributors.



You must understand how the complete SEO action plan fits together, what resources are needed, how contributors should be directed, and whether the completed work meets the required standard.

Required Healthcare SEO Experience

Applicants without direct healthcare or medical SEO experience will not be considered.



Your experience should include work with one or more healthcare business models, such as:



Physician practices or specialty clinics

Dental or dental-specialty organizations

Home health, home care, hospice, or senior care

Physical therapy, rehabilitation, chiropractic, or wellness

Sleep medicine

Medical transportation

Medical devices or diagnostics

Healthcare SaaS

Digital health or health technology

Healthcare e-commerce or clinically focused products



You do not need experience in every category.



We strongly value candidates who understand both:



Patient-facing healthcare SEO

B2B healthcare SEO for products, devices, diagnostics, software, or health technology



Experience serving U.S. healthcare clients is strongly preferred.



Exceptional candidates who have successfully managed healthcare SEO campaigns within other countries will also be considered when they can demonstrate measurable outcomes, strong strategic thinking, and the ability to learn the U.S. healthcare market.

What You Must Bring

Proven experience developing healthcare SEO strategies

Healthcare case studies, websites, or portfolio examples

Strong technical SEO knowledge

Strong content and topical-authority strategy experience

Experience with local SEO and authority building

Experience coordinating or managing a complete SEO action plan

Strong knowledge of Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, GA4, or comparable tools

Understanding of healthcare trust, clinical accuracy, and content sensitivities

Excellent written and spoken English

Strong communication and independent judgment

The ability to explain why a strategy is being recommended

A willingness to question assumptions and contribute ideas rather than simply follow instructions

Who Will Thrive in This Role

You will likely thrive at MedGains if you:



Ask thoughtful questions before recommending tactics

Enjoy researching complex healthcare markets

Care about business outcomes rather than completed task counts

Identify problems and opportunities proactively

Investigate unfamiliar healthcare subjects instead of making assumptions

Can respectfully challenge an idea when you see a stronger direction

Welcome direct and thoughtful feedback

Want to deepen your expertise in traditional SEO and AI-driven search

Want your thinking to influence how a growing healthcare agency develops its standards



This role is not suitable for someone who relies on generic templates, surface-level research, automated content without meaningful review, or the same SEO formula for every healthcare client.

Hours and Compensation

The position will begin on an hourly contractor basis with responsibility for one active healthcare SEO campaign.



The starting workload is expected to be approximately 10–30 approved hours per month depending on first wave of SEO campaigns.



A note on hours: the first month of a new campaign is setup-heavy such as the audit, Google Business Profile work, core service and location pages, and initial research. So hours will run toward the top of that range early on. Once the foundational work is complete, monthly hours on a single campaign may settle somewhat before growing again as additional clients are assigned.



Actual weekly hours may vary depending on campaign priorities, deadlines, meetings, and how the strategist organizes and performs the work.



Starting compensation is $8.14–$12.21 per hour, based on:



Direct healthcare SEO experience

Strategic capabilities

Demonstrated campaign results

Communication skills

Technical knowledge

Level of responsibility

Work personally performed



Exceptional candidates with extensive healthcare SEO leadership, U.S. healthcare campaign experience, or proven medical-device and healthcare SaaS results may be considered above the posted range. 



The initial campaign will have a maximum allowance of 40 approved hours per month. Any hours beyond that limit must be discussed and approved by MedGains in advance.

Schedule and Availability

Some availability during Pacific Time is preferred for communication, collaboration, and occasional meetings.



However, the schedule is not intended to be a strict daily shift.



MedGains is willing to discuss and negotiate a reasonable overnight or early-morning schedule with the selected candidate during the interview process.



The exact availability window may vary depending on:



The candidate’s existing schedule

Campaign requirements

Client meetings

Deadlines

Communication needs

The number of assigned campaigns



Much of the strategist’s work may be completed independently, provided communication remains dependable and agreed deadlines are met.

Growth Opportunity

The selected strategist will initially manage one healthcare SEO campaign.



As they demonstrate:



Strong strategic judgment

Dependable communication

Quality execution

Efficient use of approved hours

Clear reporting

Measurable campaign progress

The ability to coordinate supporting contributors



Additional MedGains healthcare SEO clients may be assigned.



This will allow the strategist’s approved hours, monthly earnings, responsibilities, and influence within MedGains to grow.



Once the strategist is successfully managing approximately three steady SEO campaigns, the hourly contractor arrangement may transition into a fixed monthly contractor retainer.



The monthly compensation will be based on the number and complexity of assigned campaigns, demonstrated performance, and level of strategic ownership.

How to Apply

Please include all of the following in your application:



A brief explanation of your direct healthcare or medical SEO experience

The healthcare sectors you have worked in

One healthcare SEO campaign you are most proud of

The strategy you developed for that campaign

The measurable results achieved

Links to relevant websites, case studies, reports, or portfolio examples

Your experience with medical devices, diagnostics, healthcare SaaS, digital health, or other B2B healthcare companies

The SEO tools you regularly use

Your requested hourly rate within the posted range

Your approximate monthly availability

Your preferred working hours and ability to provide some Pacific Time overlap



Begin the subject line of your application with:



HEALTHCARE SEARCH STRATEGIST



Applications without direct healthcare SEO examples or evidence will not be considered.



We are not looking for someone to quietly complete assignments.



We are looking for a serious healthcare SEO strategist who wants to contribute ideas, strengthen campaigns, grow with the agency, and help shape the future of healthcare search at MedGains.

title: Job Title: Video Editor for Ongoing Social Media Ads (2 Videos to Start)
description:
Hey everyone! 



We are looking to partner with a talented video editor to help us create high-converting
 video ads.



Right now, we are looking to get 2 solar videos created immediately. 

We already have the complete scripts, visual cues, and graphic concepts locked in—we just need a creative editor to bring them to life by sourcing the right footage, pacing it to a great beat, and making it look fantastic.



What We Are Looking For (The Style):



Real & Authentic: We want to steer clear of overly polished, bright corporate stock footage or smiling actors. We want this to look authentic, featuring clips of real, hardworking people on actual, messy job sites—sweating, drilling, running conduit, and putting in the work.



Color Direction: We want to stand out from typical solar ads, so please no bright green and no yellow graphics or text. We are aiming for a premium, high-contrast, moody aesthetic (think dark grays, deep blues, and crisp white).



Energy: Fast, cinematic cuts driven by a heavy, rhythmic blues-rock or hard rock drum beat.



Text: Clear, kinetic text overlays that match the voiceover so the ad makes total sense even when watched on mute.



Ongoing Opportunity:

This isn't a one-off project! We are looking for a reliable, go-to editor who we can work with long-term. If we work well together on these first two ads, we have a steady stream of ongoing video creation and variation work lined up for the future.



How to Apply:

Please drop a link to your portfolio or share some of your previous work. 

Please also send through your all-inclusive price for completing these first 2 videos. 



Looking forward to working together!

title: Trailer Management Admin (Urgent)
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 400+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data entry role. You're the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate and flags problems before they cost us time and money. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don't let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with dispatchers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, logistics coordination, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems (a plus)

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Monday - Friday 7 AM - 5 PM CDT | Tuesday - Sunday 3 PM - 1 AM CDT | Wednesday - Monday 7 AM - 5 PM CDT

• Possible Shift (only if assigned): 11 PM - 9 AM CDT (San Antonio time)

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Possible Hubstaff time tracking during shifts, but is not currently in use.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a US freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former fleet coordinators, logistics admins, or dispatch support staff who are tired of BPO environments

• Fleet admins who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You manage trailers like they are your business.

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.



This role is built for someone who takes pride in maintaining control over moving assets, ensuring trailers are accounted for, properly assigned, and always operational. If you value structure, accuracy, and keeping operations running clean behind the scenes, you’ll thrive in this role.



Apply Here: 



Visit Us

title: Transportation Tracker
description:
AJG Transport is expanding its route operations division and seeking a reliable, detail-oriented professional to help support and streamline our daily transportation duties, with a primary focus on Memphis lanes. We are looking for a Transportation Tracker to support real time fleet movement, manage load data accuracy, and ensure smooth coordination between drivers, customers, and internal teams.



Role Overview

As an Transportation Tracker, you will serve as a real time control point within route operations. Your responsibility is to ensure loads are properly assigned, tracked, updated, and documented while maintaining consistent communication across drivers, brokers, and customers. You will operate within structured SOPs while making fast, sound operational decisions when challenges arise.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Support Memphis execution by closely monitoring Memphis lanes, driver movement, load progress, and service requirements

• Assign and dispatch loads based on driver availability, Hours of Service, and customer requirements

• Monitor live fleet movement using GPS and TMS

• Track and update ETAs, check calls, timestamps, and delivery milestones in real time

• Enter, audit, and maintain accurate load data in Google Sheets and TMS

• Communicate continuously with drivers, brokers, and customers regarding status updates

• Identify delays, route conflicts, detention risks, or service issues and take proactive action

• Escalate operational risks to leadership when necessary

• Generate shift-based operational reports summarizing load activity, Memphis lane updates, and exceptions

• Follow dispatch, communication, and escalation SOPs consistently

• Maintain clean shift handoffs and organized documentation



What Success Looks Like

• Memphis lanes are monitored closely and executed with urgency, accuracy, and consistency

• TMS, Google Sheets, and tracking platforms reflect complete and error-free data at all times

• Scheduled updates are sent on time

• Critical loads are monitored closely and handled with urgency from start to finish

• Communication is clear, concise, and actionable, both in written updates and verbal escalations

• Operational risks and issues are flagged early with solutions, not just problems

• Shift handoffs are smooth, complete, and well documented

• You become someone the team can depend on during high-pressure situations



Who We’re Looking For

• Has experience in logistics, freight brokerage, dispatch, or transportation tracking

• Understanding of fleet coordination, load planning, and HOS awareness

• Familiar with US geography and US logistics trucking operations (a plus)

• Ability to monitor multiple loads and drivers simultaneously

• Understands urgency and prioritization in a live dispatch environment

• Communicates clearly and professionally via zoom, chat, and email

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Can monitor multiple loads at once without losing accuracy

• Pays strong attention to detail and uses sound judgment when issues arise

• Comfortable operating in high volume communication environments

• Follows instructions consistently and values clean execution

• Works well with a team and is open to feedback and coaching. Collaborates without resistance or ego



Why Join AJG Transport?

• Permanent remote opportunity

• Structured systems and clear expectations

• Hands on leadership and direct feedback

• Defined KPIs and measurable growth

• Opportunity to grow within a scaling freight brokerage

• Performance recognition and advancement potential



Schedule & Work Setup

• Direct Hire to US Company

• Full Time Role

• Permanent Work From Home

• Current Shift Need: Monday - Friday 7 AM - 5 PM CDT

• Other shifts (only if assigned): 3 PM - 1 AM CDT & 11 PM - 9 AM CDT

• Zoom presence (with camera open and unmuted audio) required

• Time tracking software used for accountability and performance support

• Shifts may adjust based on operational demand



If you thrive in fast moving transportation operations, understand the importance of real-time coordination, and can execute Memphis lanes with precision under pressure, we want to hear from you.

mber who treats their craft with high standards. To apply, please submit your application with the following:

mber so they know exactly which viewer conversations or tracking logs are currently pending.

title: Long-Term Wedding Photo Editor (Lightroom + Photoshop) – Detail-Oriented & Deadline Driven

My name is Kayla and I am a Wedding & Portrait Photographer looking for a reliable freelance photo editor to help bring my images to life with careful attention to style, detail, and consistency for a part of this year, next year and years to come ideally!



I currently have at least 4 weddings to edit between March and April, plus 20 weddings booked for this year from May - November with sessions scattered throughout the year. This is the work I have guaranteed right now, but as I book more sessions and weddings, they will be added onto a task board right away so that you can see well in advance what I'll need help with and when it would be due, which will give you plenty of time to plan your life and other editing jobs accordingly around that.



As a heads up, I use an Ai editing tool to help me with the base edit so that the editing process is as efficient as possible. This means you would receive a Lightroom catalog with the images partially or mostly edited, but I still need help getting them fully completed through cropping, straightening, brush work, spot removal / eliminating distractions exposure + temperature correction, etc. and ensuring the images match my signature style.



Since the Ai editing tool will be taking care of the base edit, this means that it will take you less time per image to finish the edit to the standard I'm looking for since there will already be a base edit applied. For this reason, I'm looking for someone who can fine tune these images for $0.12 CAD per image. There will also be Photoshop retouching needed on a case by case basis, which includes advanced object removal and head swaps (only on selected images) and comes at an additional pay at $0.12 CAD per image.



Here is what I need help with:



-Fine tuning/editing about
+ photos per wedding in Lightroom using a preset I work with

mbers.

* Support referrals and prior authorizations as responsibilities grow

* Suggest practical improvements to existing processes

* Maintain organized digital files

* Communicate professionally with the physician

* Complete assigned tasks accurately and on time

The ideal candidate enjoys creating order from complexity.



You are naturally organized, dependable, and detail-oriented.

You take pride in producing accurate work and catching details that others might overlook.



You are comfortable learning new technology but do not need previous AI expertise.

Healthcare experience is strongly preferred.

* Pharmacist

* Medical Technologist

* Medical Assistant

* Medical Scribe

* Healthcare Virtual Assistant

* Excellent written English

* Exceptional attention to detail

* Organization

* Critical thinking

* Professional communication

* Ability to follow standardized workflows

* Willingness to learn new software



Experience using ChatGPT or other AI tools is a plus, but not required. We will train you to use our physician-developed AI documentation system.



---



# Workspace & Technology Requirements



Because this position involves confidential medical information, applicants must have:



* A private workspace where patient information cannot be viewed by others

* A reliable computer

* Stable high-speed internet

* Willingness to use secure passwords and multi-factor authentication

* Willingness to comply with HIPAA privacy and confidentiality requirements

* Willingness to sign confidentiality agreements before beginning work

---



# Schedule



Initially:



* Approximately 15–20 hours per week



As the practice grows:



* Opportunity for increased hours

* Expanded responsibilities

* Long-term career growth



---



# Why This Position Is Different



We're building long-term systems—not just completing tasks.



The physician develops the clinical workflows and AI documentation systems.



Your role is to operate those systems with accuracy, identify opportunities for improvement, and help build efficient clinical operations.



Outstanding tea
mbers will have opportunities to expand into broader clinical operations, workflow optimization, quality improvement, and other healthcare projects as our organization grows.



---

About the Role

You will act as the central link between drivers and the operations team. You will manage day-to-day driver needs while building and adjusting daily dispatch schedules to prevent trucks from sitting idle and loads from running late. When a driver encounters an issue, you are the person they contact. When schedules, equipment, freight requirements, or Hours of Service limitations change, you are responsible for coordinating the solution.



Success in this role requires consistent execution, urgency, accountability, and clear communication. Drivers must remain supported, schedules must stay organized, equipment must remain productive, and operational issues must be resolved before they escalate.



Why This Role Matters

This is not a call center dispatch seat. This is driver centric fleet operations. You are the face of the company to our drivers and the engine of our daily execution. If your communication is slow, equipment sits and drivers get frustrated. If you manage and schedule with discipline and urgency, drivers stay, trucks run, and freight moves on time.



What You’ll Be Doing



Driver Management (first point of contact)

• Be the primary daily contact for an assigned group of drivers, the person they trust and call first.

• Own driver issues day to day: schedule questions, equipment, routing, pay questions routed correctly, and general support.

• Build relationships that keep drivers satisfied, informed, and retained. A driver who feels managed and supported stays.



Driver Scheduling & Dispatch

• Build and manage the daily driver schedule across local, regional, and dedicated lane assignments.

• Assign loads and coordinate trucks with precision and urgency, the right driver on the right run and on time.

• Adjust the schedule in real time as freight, HOS, and equipment realities change.



Execution & Uptime

• Keep trucks moving, eliminate idle time, cover every scheduled run, and close gaps before they cost us.

Compliance Support

Risk Mitigation

• Proactively spot and solve issues before they escalate such as HOS conflicts, misrouted trucks, idle equipment, and coverage gaps.



Collaborative Execution

• Work alongside leadership, recruiting, and the brokerage/ops team to cover shifts and resolve issues in real time.



Operational Logging

What You'll Be Measured On

• Driver satisfaction and retention within your assigned group

• On-time dispatch and schedule adherence

• Tractor and trailer uptime; reduction of idle-asset time

• Response time to driver issues and operational i

• Communication clarity and escalation speed

• Adherence to SOPs, protocols, and dispatch audit standards



Qualifications

• 2+ years in asset-based dispatch, driver management, fleet coordination, or driver scheduling

• Experience with ELD platforms and routing/dispatch software

• Clear and assertive communicator who stays calm and decisive under pressure

• Comfortable in a live and fast-moving operational setting

• Schedule flexibility, including weekend and high volume window availability

Schedule & Work Setup

If you thrive in fast moving transportation operations, understand the importance of real-time coordination, and can execute with precision under pressure, we want to hear from you.

title: Credit Report & Dispute Specialist
description:
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–11:00 AM Central Time

Daily Check-In: 7:30 AM Central Time

Hours: 15 hours per week

Hourly Pay: $7 per hour

Paychecks are paid every 15th and 30th of each month



TO APPLY FOR THIS POSITION, FOLLOW THE INSTRUCTIONS AT THE END OF THIS APPLICATION



This position will begin at 15 hours per week. Our goal is to increase the specialist’s hours as the 850 Club Membership grows. Applicants should prepare to work more hours as more members join.



About the Position



850 Club Credit is hiring an experienced Credit Report & Dispute Specialist to manage client disputes, educate our members, and answer credit-report-related questions inside our online community.



This is not simply a letter-processing position. We need someone who can carefully review credit reports, identify potential reporting issues, prepare accurate disputes, track results, and explain the process in an easy-to-understand way.



Primary Responsibilities

Review three-bureau credit reports.

Identify potentially inaccurate, incomplete, duplicated, outdated, or unauthorized information.

Prepare customized dispute letters using company-approved procedures and AI tools.

Create separate dispute letters for Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion.

Review all AI-generated letters for accuracy before submission.

Process monthly dispute rounds for assigned clients.

Compare updated reports with previous reports.

Track disputed accounts, submission dates, responses, results, and follow-up actions.

Update client records and dispute progress inside our systems.

Prepare CFPB complaint drafts when appropriate and approved by management.

Escalate complicated cases to management.

Conduct one live, one-hour dispute education training every week for DIY 850 Club members.

Answer dispute-related questions inside the 850 Club community.

Help members understand realistic timelines, possible outcomes, and next steps.

Send a daily or end-of-shift progress report.

Protect all client information and follow company privacy procedures.

Important Expectations



The specialist must:



Never guarantee deletions or credit-score increases.

Never dispute information simply because it is negative.

Only dispute information the client has identified or confirmed as potentially inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, duplicated, or unauthorized.

Never invent dispute reasons, facts, or supporting information.

Communicate professionally and avoid providing legal advice.

Complete work accurately and on time.

Be comfortable speaking and teaching during weekly virtual sessions.

Be available consistently during the required Central Time schedule.

Qualifications

Previous experience processing consumer credit disputes.

Strong knowledge of Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion credit reports.

Experience reviewing collections, charge-offs, late payments, inquiries, personal information, public records, and other derogatory accounts.

Familiarity with the Fair Credit Reporting Act, CFPB complaints, identity-theft disputes, and Metro 2 reporting is preferred.

Strong written and spoken English.

Comfortable conducting live virtual training.

Comfortable using ChatGPT or similar AI tools.

Experience with GoHighLevel, Skool, Trello, Lob, or credit-repair software is helpful but not required.

Reliable computer, high-speed internet, webcam, microphone, and backup internet access.

Strong attention to detail and ability to protect confidential client information.



TO APPLY FOR THIS POSITION, REPLY WITH SUBJECT LINE "I AM YOUR DISPUTE SPECIALIST" & Answer the following questions:

1. Do you speak strong english? (this role requires recorded zoom calls of dispute education to our clients) 

Include your resume or portfolio. 

2. How many years of credit-repair or credit-dispute experience do you have?

3. What experience do you have creating CFPB complaints?

4. What do you understand about the FCRA and Metro 2 reporting?

5. How would you respond to a member who asks, “Can you guarantee this account will be deleted?”

title: Insurance Billing Specialist
description:
Summary

# Contract Revenue Cycle Biller



**Contract Position | Remote | Behavioral Health Revenue Cycle (RTC, PHP, and IOP)**



## Overview



The Hope Group operates multiple behavioral health care businesses, serving more than 100 clients at any given time. We are seeking a highly competent Contract Revenue Cycle Biller to manage billing and accounts receivable for approximately 20 active clients.



Most client funding comes from commercial insurance. However, some clients may be funded through school districts, state agencies, private pay arrangements, or other contracted funding sources. This role is responsible for making sure each funding source is billed accurately, invoices and claims are submitted on time, and payments are collected and properly recorded.



This position is critical to maintaining financial health and preventing administrative issues from disrupting client care. The ideal candidate has strong behavioral health billing experience, is highly organized and proactive, and can independently manage accounts from initial authorization or funding verification through final payment.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Insurance Billing and Claims Management



* Submit accurate and timely insurance claims for RTC, PHP, and IOP services

* Ensure proper coding, modifiers, rates, and documentation alignment before submission

* Monitor claim status and proactively resolve denials, rejections, and underpayments

* Track claims through full payment resolution

* Maintain clean and organized billing records for all clients



### School District, State, and Private Pay Billing



* Prepare and submit invoices to school districts, state agencies, families, and other funding partners

* Confirm billing rates, service dates, purchase orders, contracts, and supporting documentation

* Track invoices from submission through payment

* Follow up on overdue balances and resolve missing documentation or payment issues

* Reconcile payments, adjustments, EOBs, remittance notices, and outstanding balances

### Coordination, Tracking, and Communication

* Maintain accurate tracking by client, payer, funding source, invoice, claim, and payment status

## Expected Scope



* Approximately 20 active clients

## Preferred Qualifications

title: Video Editor – Instagram Reels & YouTube (German-Language Fitness Content)
description:
We're an online fitness coaching brand looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Video Editor to join our team long-term, part-time.



YOUR MAIN JOB

Edit short-form Instagram Reels (and later, longer YouTube videos) for a German-speaking fitness/nutrition coach.



IMPORTANT — ALL RAW FOOTAGE IS IN GERMAN

You do not need to speak German. Before editing, you will use a transcription + translation tool (e.g. Descript, otter.ai, or similar, combined with Google Translate/DeepL) to transcribe the German audio and translate it into English. This lets you understand exactly what's being said and what the video is about, so you can make smart editing decisions (hooks, cuts, pacing) even without understanding German directly. This step is required for every video.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Rough-cut raw talking-head footage: remove filler words, dead air, and retakes; keep only the cleanest take

- Craft strong hooks in the first 1-3 seconds (text overlays, zoom-ins, pattern interrupts)

- Add b-roll, styled burned-in captions/subtitles, sound design, and simple motion graphics

- Follow an established visual style/template once trained on it

- Deliver polished vertical Reels (9:16) and, later, longer-form YouTube videos (16:9)

- Turn videos around quickly and reliably; communicate proactively if anything is unclear



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Proven experience editing short-form content (Reels/TikTok/Shorts) — please share a portfolio or reel of your best edits

- Strong sense for pacing, hooks, and what keeps viewers watching

- Comfortable using transcription/translation tools to work with non-English (German) audio

- Skilled in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar (please tell us which tool you use)

- Reliable internet connection and own equipment

- Good written English communication



This is a part-time, long-term role with room to grow into more responsibility (e.g. YouTube long-form editing) as we scale.

title: Lead Platform Engineer — Internal Operations Platform
description:
Eagle Production Co. | Wall Township, NJ (Hybrid or Remote for the right candidate) | Full-Time



About Eagle Production Co.

Eagle Production Co. is a nationwide AV equipment rental and production company based in New Jersey, running for over a decade. 



We rent and support audio, video, lighting, rigging, and power equipment for events across the country — from corporate premieres to touring productions.



Over the past year we’ve built something most companies our size don’t have: a full custom operations platform that runs the business — CRM, quoting, invoicing, payments, inventory availability, COI compliance, crew staffing, payroll support, fleet logistics, and customer/freelancer/driver portals. It was built fast using AI-assisted development (Lovable + Supabase), it’s live, it processes real money, and it works.

Now it needs an owner.



The Role

You will take over our platform as its dedicated engineer and technical owner. This is not a greenfield job and it’s not maintenance-only — it’s both harder and more interesting than either. You’ll inherit a large, live, AI-built codebase (~700 files, 150+ Supabase edge functions, 100+ database tables) and be responsible for three things:

 1. Keep it stable. New features have historically broken existing ones. You’ll change that — with tests around the money logic, disciplined releases, and real code review of every change, whether written by you or by AI tools.

 2. Keep it moving. The feature roadmap doesn’t stop. You’ll ship new functionality weekly, working directly with the CEO, using AI-assisted development where it’s fast and hand-written code where it’s right.

 3. Lead the migration off Flex Rental Solutions. Our inventory and operations still run partly on Flex. Over the next phases of our roadmap, this platform becomes the single hub for all company operations. You’ll architect and execute that migration — inventory, scanning, availability, warehouse workflows — without disrupting live operations.



What You’ll Do

 • Own the full stack: React/TypeScript frontend, Supabase backend (Postgres, RLS, edge functions, storage, cron), and the integrations around them (payment processing, QuickBooks, Gmail, Flex API, HubSpot, shipping/logistics APIs)

 • Stabilize and harden the existing codebase: eliminate duplicate logic, add a test suite around pricing, tax, invoicing, and payment flows, and close security gaps (RLS coverage, endpoint auth, storage policies)

 • Build new features end to end from CEO-defined requirements — often same-week turnaround

 • Plan and execute the Flex migration in phases: data model, sync strategy, cutover plan, rollback plan

 • Establish engineering discipline that survives AI-assisted development: GitHub-based workflow, pre-change audits, batched changes, post-change verification

 • Support the team using the platform daily (sales, warehouse, finance, HR) — triage issues fast, communicate clearly with non-technical users

 • Document what you build so the company is never dependent on any one tool or person

What We’re Looking For



Required:

 • 5+ years full-stack experience with deep React + TypeScript

 • Strong PostgreSQL, including Row-Level Security, and hands-on Supabase (or equivalent: Firebase + SQL, Hasura, etc.)

 • Experience owning a production system that handles real money — payments, invoicing, or e-commerce — and the paranoia that comes with it

 • Fluency with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, Copilot or similar) AND the judgment to review, constrain, and correct what those tools produce. We work AI-first here; we don’t work AI-blind.

 • Experience integrating third-party APIs (payment gateways, accounting,
)

 • Ability to work directly with a fast-moving, hands-on CEO: translate business requirements into working software quickly, push back when something is a bad idea, and explain technical tradeoffs in plain English

Strongly preferred:

 • Experience inheriting and stabilizing a large existing codebase (rescue/refactor work)

 • Migration experience: replacing a legacy system of record without downtime

 • Testing discipline: Vitest/Jest, and knowing what’s worth testing in a business app

Nice to have:

 • Rental, events, AV, or logistics industry exposure

 • Flex Rental Solutions, QuickBooks API, or Cardknox/payment gateway experience

 • Mobile/PWA experience (our warehouse runs barcode scanning on the platform)

What This Job Is Not

 • Not a junior role with AI doing the thinking — AI writes a lot of first drafts here; you own correctness

 • Not a big-company pace — decisions happen in hours, not sprints

 • Not siloed — you’ll talk to warehouse staff, salespeople, and the CEO in the same day

Compensation & Details

 • Salary: based on experience,

title: HIRING: Full-Time Video Editor for a 7-Figure Supplement Brand
description:

* Work closely with our Creative Manager, Creative Strategists, and other Video Editors

* Source relevant raw footage, b-roll, visuals, and voiceovers

* Test new formats, trends, angles, and storytelling structures

* Deliver approximately 15 new ad concepts per week

* Iterate quickly on winning creatives to produce new variations



What We’re Looking For



* Experience editing performance-driven Meta ads

* A strong portfolio of UGC, short-form, VSL, or direct-response video ads

* A clear understanding of hooks, consumer psychology, pacing, and storytelling

* The ability to identify why an ad is likely to convert

* Experience working with performance metrics and creative testing

* Strong attention to detail

* Reliable communication and the ability to meet deadlines

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with a high creative output

* Willingness to test, learn, receive feedback, and iterate quickly

* A long-term mindset and genuine motivation to grow with the company



What You’ll Get



* Fixed salary of $1,000 USD per month

* A highly attractive performance-based bonus structure

* Significant earning potential when your creatives perform

* A fully remote, long-term position

* Direct collaboration with experienced editors, strategists, and the founder

* Clear guidance and feedback from a dedicated Creative Manager

* Access to performance data so you can understand which creatives are winning

* Opportunities to develop your direct-response and performance-marketing skills

How to Apply
