title: Accounts Payable Coordinator
description:
What to Expect

Wonderist Agency is a full-service marketing agency that supports 1,200+ dentists around the country. We pride ourselves on ditching the old fashioned marketing model of stock photos and templated sites. We strive to tell our clients’ stories with bespoke brands, impactful photo and video shoots, and stunning website design (Here is a great example of our work: 
)



We’re a team of over 90+ passionate marketers with our headquarters nestled in sunny San Diego. We are walking distance from local hangouts, bars, and the famed Liberty Station. While many companies simply check the required boxes when it comes to culture, a well-balanced team and positive office culture has been the core of our success from the start. We are a social team at heart, and that is one constant that hasn’t changed with all the movement this economy and industry has seen. We have embraced a hybrid work model where local tea
mbers come in at least two days a week. This allows us to work from home and have flexibility, without altogether forgoing the excitement and 
nts of collaboration and inspiration you can only get from in-person time. Not to mention, we also genuinely enjoy spending time together and socializing.



We celebrate new ideas and prioritize a culture of trust and respect where tea
mbers can grow and take risks. Each quarter we host events under our four cultural pillars; health & wellness, personal & professional development, social good, and social. We are proud to have been named:

San Diego Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in: 2018, 2021, 2022 and 2023, Inc 5000 Regionals Fastest Growing Companies in: 2021, 2022, 2024, 2025, and 2026, San Diego Business Journal’s Fastest Growing Private Companies list in 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, and 2024, Inc Best Workplaces list in: 2024 and 2025, and Inc. 5000 for the last 6 years (
)!



If you work at Wonderist, you likely enjoy a challenge, appreciate autonomy, actually care about clients, and are looking for a team that you can enjoy being part of.



Job Description

The Accounts Payable Associate is responsible for managing the end-to-end payables process at Wonderist Agency across both operating entities. This includes processing vendor invoices, reconciling statements, resolving billing discrepancies, and maintaining accurate financial records. This role works closely with the accounting team and executive suite and reports directly to Finance Operations Manager.



Key Responsibilities

Weekly

Review and process incoming vendor invoices across both entities (Wonderist Agency and Nomos Marketing)

Match invoices to purchase orders or approvals and route for sign-off as needed

Respond to vendor inquiries regarding payment status within 24 hours

Log all payables in accounting software and ensure coding accuracy by department and entity

Flag any discrepancies, duplicate charges, or overbilling for resolution

Review and process approved employee expense reimbursements, ensuring proper coding and timely payment

Monitor and reconcile Rippling Spend corporate card transactions against receipts and coding by department and entity

Review and process contractor invoices, including 1099-eligible payments submitted via Rippling or directly by contractors

Attend weekly finance check-in with leadership; come prepared with a current AP snapshot including aged items, open disputes, and any items requiring a decision or escalation



Monthly

Reconcile vendor statements against internal records and resolve any variances

Prepare a monthly AP aging report

Process approved payment runs and confirm remittance details with vendors

Support month-end close by providing complete and accurate AP data

Maintain organized digital records of all invoices, approvals, and payment confirmations

Reconcile Rippling Spend corporate card statements against internal records and resolve any variances



Quarterly/As Needed

Assist with audit preparation by compiling AP documentation as requested

Identify opportunities to streamline AP workflows or improve vendor billing accuracy

Support annual 1099 preparation by maintaining accurate vendor payment records throughout the year

Participate in process improvement initiatives related to finance operations

Collect and maintain W-9s for all new vendors and contractors at time of onboarding; maintain accurate vendor master file to support 1099 preparation

Support annual 1099 preparation for all eligible vendors and contractors, including payments processed via Rippling and direct invoice



Performance Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by:

Invoice processing accuracy (target: 99%+)

On-time payment execution with no missed due dates

AP aging report delivery on schedule each month

Vendor dispute resolution time

Quality and completeness of records for month-end close



Essential Functions: What You’ll Do

Invoice Processing and Payment Execution: Review, code, and process vendor invoices with accuracy and urgency. Ensure all invoices are matched to proper approvals before payment. Execute payment runs on schedule and confirm remittance with vendors as appropriate.

Vendor Relationship Management: Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for vendor billing inquiries. Maintain professional and responsive communication to protect vendor relationships while advocating for Wonderist's financial interests when discrepancies arise.

Discrepancy Resolution: Identify and investigate billing errors, duplicate charges, and overbilling situations. Document disputes clearly, communicate with vendors to reach resolution, and ensure credits or corrections are reflected accurately in the system.

Record Keeping and Reporting: Maintain complete and organized AP records in the accounting system. Produce monthly aging reports and provide data to support month-end close, audits, and leadership reporting as needed.

Cross-Entity Coordination: Manage payables across both operating entities (Wonderist Agency and Nomos Marketing), applying accurate entity coding and maintaining clear separation of records.

Rippling Spend and Expense Management: Reconcile corporate card transactions in Rippling Spend and process employee reimbursement requests. Ensure all card activity is coded accurately by department and entity and that receipts and approvals are documented.

Inter-Entity Transactions: Support accurate coding and reconciliation of any shared costs or allocated expenses across Wonderist Agency and Nomos Marketing, maintaining clear separation of records between entities.



Core Competencies: What you’ll bring to the role

Attention to Detail: You catch errors before they become problems. You verify totals, check coding, and review statements line by line. Nothing gets processed without confirmation.

Integrity: You handle sensitive financial information with discretion and operate with a high standard of accuracy and honesty.

Organization and Follow-Through: You manage a high volume of invoices and vendor communications without letting anything fall through the cracks. You maintain clear records and follow up proactively.

Communication and Professionalism: You correspond clearly and professionally with vendors and internal tea
mbers. You escalate issues with the right information and context so they can be resolved quickly.

Systems Proficiency: You are comfortable working in accounting software and picking up new tools. Experience with QuickBooks, Xero, or similar platforms is essential. Experience with Rippling Spend, 
, or similar platforms is a plus



Must-Have Qualifications

2+ years of accounts payable or bookkeeping experience

Proficiency with accounting software such as QuickBooks, Xero, or similar

Strong command of written English for vendor and internal communication

High attention to detail and comfort working with high-volume invoice environments

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines with minimal supervision

Reliable internet connection and ability to work during Pacific Time business hours (partial overlap required)

Payment execution authority will be granted by leadership up to an approved threshold; comfort initiating and confirming payment runs within those parameters is required



Bonus Points for Applicants With…

(if you don’t have these but are organized and want to learn, we want to hear from you!)

Experience supporting multi-entity accounting environments

Familiarity with Rippling, Ramp, 
, or similar platforms

Background in agency, marketing, or professional services environments

Experience with 1099 preparation and vendor compliance



This is a Full-Time Salaried position. This role is structured as an EOR agreement with Rippling EOR and Wonderist Agency.

title: GHL & AI Automation Specialist
description:
Part-time, long-term, remote. Reports to Coach Cass.

Please apply via this link: 





Who we are. We’re a love coaching practice for professional women over 40. We run coaching programs, a membership, live events, and international retreats, and almost everything we do runs through GoHighLevel (white-labeled for us as ConvertAndFlow), connected to Spiffy, 
, Zoom, Slack, and Canva.



The honest problem we’re hiring you to fix. Right now our GHL work is split across the team and built reactively, launch by launch. Pages, workflows, tags, and payment automations get built fast under deadline, so things break, get missed, or live only in one person’s head. No one owns
 deliverability. No one owns the evergreen sequences that should run without us. And too little gets documented. We’re hiring one person to take all of that off the team’s plate and turn it into one owned, tested, documented system.



This is an ownership role, not a task list. You’ll audit what exists, tell us what’s wrong, and build what’s next without waiting to be asked.



What you’ll own



 •
 deliverability. Keep us landing in the inbox, not spam. Authentication, list hygiene, engagement-based sending, sunset policies for unengaged contacts, and healthy sending practices. This is our single biggest gap, so it’s your first priority.

 • Tagging and segmentation. A clean, logical CRM structure where every tag means something and our lists can actually be trusted.

 • Evergreen nurture sequences.
 and SMS that run on their own and move people toward our programs, events, and retreats. Welcome, reactivation, and post-event flows that don’t need us to press send.

 • Pages. Landing, funnel, checkout, and thank-you pages built inside GHL, including payment plans, discount codes, and clean Spiffy-to-ConvertAndFlow handoffs. Templatized so launches stop being built from scratch every time.

 • Workflow QA. Every automation tested before it goes live, not debugged after. No more “it’s not working” surprises on launch day.

 • AI-assisted automation. Build and improve AI-assisted follow-up and messaging, and help keep our 
 scenarios running.

 • SOPs. Document every system as you build it, unprompted, so a non-technical teammate can follow it.



Week to week



 • Support our weekly Tuesday webinar loop: after each one, update the landing page and ads and adjust the next campaign

 • Build and troubleshoot workflows, tags, and pages for upcoming launches, events, and retreats

 • Monitor deliverability, engagement, and drop-off, and report what the numbers say

 • Proactively flag gaps and recommend the next build



You’re a strong fit if you



 • Have proven, hands-on GoHighLevel experience and can show real builds

 • Understand CRM logic, conditional workflows, and tagging deeply

 • Genuinely understand
 deliverability, not just
 sending

 • Document as you go and think in systems, not tickets

 • Are proactive: you spot the broken thing and fix it before it’s assigned



Bonus: GHL Certified Admin, Make or Zapier, coaching/membership/event businesses, evergreen webinar funnels, Spiffy.



How we work



Part-time, long-term, remote, deliverable-based. Required team huddles Mon 9am EST and Tue, Thu, Fri 9:30am EST. We start with one small paid test build before committing long term.



What success looks like



 • First 30 days: full audit of our GHL location, deliverability basics fixed, tagging cleaned up, and what exists documented.

 • By 60 days: an evergreen nurture engine live, and launch pages templatized so we stop rebuilding from scratch.

 • By 90 days: AI-assisted follow-up running, Make scenarios stable, and an SOP library covering every core system, with you bringing us the next build before we ask.

title: Part-Time SEO Backlink Outreach Coordinator (Virtual Assistant)
description:
Position Overview

Today's Business (TB) is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency seeking a Part-Time SEO Backlink Outreach Coordinator to run ongoing, ethical white-hat link building campaigns for our client roster — including Amplifi (Braiden Shaw), Ammerländer, and our full portfolio of SEO clients.



This role is 100% focused on earning high-quality, credible, dofollow backlinks that genuinely improve each client's domain authority and organic visibility. You will identify relevant sites, vet them against real quality standards, pitch real placement opportunities, coordinate with our internal SEO/content team on the right target pages and anchor text, and manage every link from first outreach through to a confirmed, live placement. This is not a directory-submission or PBN/link-farm role — every link earned must come from a legitimate, editorially relevant, human-reviewed placement.

What "Ethical, White-Hat" Means for This Role

Only pursue placements on real, active, editorially-run websites with genuine audiences — no link farms, private blog networks (PBNs), link exchanges, or paid-link schemes disguised as editorial content

Prioritize dofollow links, but never misrepresent a paid or sponsored placement as organic/editorial

Target sites and pages that are topically relevant to the client's industry — a finance client gets finance/wealth placements, a food/CPG client gets food/recipe/retail placements, etc.

Respect every publisher's guidelines, disclosure requirements, and "no" — no repeated badgering after a decline

Never buy links from known link-selling networks or use automated/spam outreach tools that mass-blast irrelevant sites

Vetting a Site Before You Pitch It

"High quality" isn't a feeling — every prospect gets checked against real criteria before any outreach goes out:



Domain Rating (DR/DA): prioritize established, authoritative sites over brand-new or low-authority ones

Spam Score: avoid domains with high spam signals (thin content, unnatural link patterns, suspicious TLDs) — when in doubt, run it through Ahrefs/Moz before pitching

Real organic traffic: the site should have actual visitors, not just a DR number with no real audience behind it

Topical relevance: the site's content/audience should genuinely relate to the client's industry — a finance placement for Amplifi, a food/retail placement for Ammerländer, etc.

Real editorial site, not a link farm: confirm there's an actual publication with real authors, regular content, and a real audience — not a site that exists purely to sell links

Flag any borderline case to the SEO team in Slack rather than guessing



Core Responsibilities



Outreach Execution



Identify and qualify backlink opportunities daily across the assigned client roster, including:

"Best of" / roundup list inclusion (e.g., best cheese brands, best credit cards, best investing tools)

Guest post and expert-contributor pitches to relevant blogs and trade publications

HARO/journalist-request style expert-commentary opportunities

Industry and trade association outreach (e.g., professional/trade organizations relevant to the client's category)

Competitor backlink gap outreach (sites linking to competitors but not the client)

Broken-link and unlinked-brand-mention outreach (sites mentioning the brand/product without a working link)

Resource page and "recommended tools/reading" page outreach

Send personalized, non-templated-feeling outreach
s (using TB's approved templates as a starting framework, not a copy-paste script)

Track every prospect and every outreach touchpoint in 
 — no outreach happens outside the board



Coordination



Coordinate with the internal SEO/content team via Slack before finalizing any pitch to confirm:

Which specific client page(s) should receive the link

Approved anchor text for each placement (contextual, keyword-aligned, non-spammy)

Any pages that are off-limits or any anchor text to avoid

Flag any opportunity that requires client-specific context, budget approval (paid placements), or legal/compliance review before pursuing



Follow-Through & Verification



Follow up on outstanding pitches on a set cadence until a final yes/no

Once a placement is confirmed, verify the link goes live, confirm it is dofollow (unless otherwise agreed), confirm the anchor text and destination URL match what was approved, and screenshot/log proof

Flag any placement that goes live incorrectly (wrong anchor text, nofollow when dofollow was promised, wrong URL) for correction with the publisher



Reporting



Target baseline: 200–300 outreach pitches per week across the client roster (adjusted up/down by client priority and season) — this is the number the weekly report is measured against

Submit a weekly report covering, at minimum:

Total outreach sent (by client)

Total responses received / response rate

New placements confirmed and gone live that week (with URLs)

Pipeline status of everything still in follow-up

Any blockers or opportunities needing internal input

Tools You'll Use


 — primary system of record for all outreach, prospect status, and link tracking

Slack — daily coordination with the SEO/content team on target pages and anchor text

Gmail/Outreach
 — outreach and follow-up

Ahrefs — used by the team to identify/qualify high-authority prospects and to confirm domain rating and dofollow status of live links (training provided if you haven't used it)



Qualifications

Prior experience in SEO link building, digital PR, or outreach/business development (agency experience a plus)

Excellent written English — outreach
s represent real client brands to real publishers and journalists

Highly organized with proven ability to manage a high volume of ongoing outreach threads without letting things fall through the cracks

Comfortable working independently against a weekly cadence and reporting deadline

Familiarity with 
 and Slack preferred; willingness to learn Ahrefs basics required

Understanding of (or willingness to quickly learn) what makes a backlink high-quality vs. low-quality/spammy — domain authority, relevance, dofollow vs. nofollow, editorial context



Time Tracking

All work hours must be logged daily using 
 (or another team-approved time tracker) — clock in at shift start, clock out at shift end, no exceptions

Time logs are reviewed against weekly output (outreach volume, follow-ups, placements confirmed) — consistent hours with consistently low output will be addressed directly

Flag any day where you're unable to hit your full scheduled hours as early as possible



Schedule

Monday through Friday

9:00 AM – 2:00 PM Eastern Time (5 hours/day, ~25 hours/week)

Remote position (Philippines-based)



Compensation

$100 USD per week

Steady improvement in response and placement rates over time

Every live placement correctly verified (dofollow status, anchor text, destination URL)

Accurate, up-to-date 
 board

On-time weekly report, every week, without reminders

What Will Get You Removed From This Role

Purchasing links, using link farms/PBNs, or any outreach practice that violates Google's webmaster guidelines

Logging outreach inconsistently or falling behind on 
 updates

Missing the weekly report without advance notice

title: Full-Time Remote Sales & Customer Success Manager
description:
About BetterYOU Fitness Centre



BetterYOU Fitness Centre is a growing 24/7 gym located in Pakenham, Victoria, Australia.



We are looking for a confident, organised and results-driven person to take full ownership of our leads, outbound calls and member retention systems.



This is not a general virtual assistant position.



Your main responsibility will be to contact new leads quickly, book appointments, follow up consistently and help retain existing gy
mbers.



Your Primary Responsibilities



New Lead Management-

Monitor incoming leads throughout your shift

Call every new lead within five minutes

Contact leads by phone, SMS and

Qualify leads and book gym tours or appointments

Follow up leads consistently until they book, join or clearly decline

Follow up missed calls, no-shows and cancelled appointments

Reactivate old leads

Keep all lead information, notes and statuses updated

Ensure no lead is forgotten or left without follow-up



Membership Renewals-

Contact members approaching the end of their membership

Encourage members to renew before their membership expires

Follow up members who have not yet made a renewal decision

Update all outcomes and notes accurately



Outstanding Payments-

Contact members with failed payments or outstanding balances

Help members arrange payment

Follow up until the payment is resolved

Escalate disputes or difficult cases to management



Member Retention and Reactivation-

Contact members who have stopped attending the gym

Contact members who may be at risk of cancelling

Find out why members have become inactive

Encourage inactive members to return

Follow up members who have expressed concerns or requested cancellation

Identify problems early and escalate them when required

Conduct scheduled member check-in calls



Lead and Marketing Administration-

Manage the gym’s lead pipeline

Track where leads are coming from

Monitor lead response times and follow-up activity

Help test different call times and follow-up methods

Report common objections and lead quality

Provide daily and weekly performance reports

Ensure lead forms, contact lists and follow-up systems are working correctly



Any other smaller admin jobs needed



Performance Expectations

You will be measured on:



Lead response time

Percentage of leads called within five minutes

Number of outbound calls completed

Contact rate

Appointments booked

Appointment attendance rate

Lead-to-member conversion rate

Membership renewals

Outstanding payments recovered

Inactive members reactivated

Cancellations prevented

Accuracy of notes and reporting



Requirements-

Excellent spoken and written English

Clear, confident and natural phone communication

Previous experience in sales, appointment setting, customer service, collections or retention

Comfortable making outbound calls every day

Able to follow scripts without sounding robotic

Strong organisation and follow-up skills

Reliable high-speed internet connection

Quiet and professional home working environment

Reliable computer and quality headset

Able to work independently without constant supervision

Comfortable being measured against clear KPIs

Strong attention to detail

Available Monday to Friday during Melbourne, Australia working hours

No conflicting job or commitments during rostered hours



Ideal Candidate-

You will be a strong fit if you:



Take ownership of your responsibilities

Act quickly when a new lead arrives

Are persistent without being pushy

Can handle rejection professionally

Enjoy speaking with customers and solving problems

Follow systems accurately

Do not need to be constantly reminded

Are motivated by targets and measurable results

Can build rapport while moving conversations toward an outcome



Experience working with gyms, fitness businesses, membership businesses or Australian customers will be highly regarded.



Training-

You will receive training on:



BetterYOU Fitness Centre memberships and services

Lead follow-up systems

Call scripts

Objection handling

Appointment booking

Membership renewals

Retention conversations

Outstanding payment follow-up

CRM and reporting requirements



Calls will be recorded and reviewed for training, coaching and quality control.



Employment Details

Full-time position

40 hours per week

Monday to Friday

9:00 AM–6:00 P
lbourne, Australia time

One-hour unpaid meal break

AUD$7 per hour during the initial 30-day probation period

Increase to AUD$10 per hour after probation based on reliability, communication, accuracy and performance

Long-term opportunity for the right person

Pay rises will be given to the correct person with proven work and results





How to Apply-

Please include:



The word BETTERYOU at the beginning of your application

A short introduction about yourself

Details of your sales, appointment-setting, outbound calling, retention or collections experience

A voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be suitable for this position

Your internet speed

A photo of your computer and headset setup

Confirmation that you can work Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 P
lbourne time

Details of any other jobs or ongoing work commitments



Please do not apply if you are uncomfortable making outbound calls, speaking with Australian customers or being accountable for performance targets.

Existing opportunities

Previous prospects

Qualified Discoveries

Audit Attendance Rate

20+ completed Local Marketing Analyses

6–8 new clients

Positive Net New MRR

title: Dashboard Builder
description:
The Dashboard Builder is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining reporting dashboards in Power BI and Looker Studio that turn raw data into clear, actionable insights. This role focuses on data transformation, visualization best practices, and reliable, automated reporting that supports strategic decision-making across the organization. This is a full-time, 8-hour daily shift position engaged as a contract role for an initial 6-month term.



ABOUT CARDONE VENTURES

Our mission is to help business owners achieve their personal, professional, and financial goals through the growth of their businesses. We work in dozens of verticals and provide strategic business guidance through courses, live events, partnerships, and investments. Our core values are the backbone of our business and guide our hiring process: we are inspirational, disciplined, accountable, transparent, aligned, and results-oriented. This company operates nationally and is growing by the day.



SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

•      Building clean, accurate, and visually clear dashboards in Power BI and Looker Studio that stakeholders trust and use daily.

•      Transforming raw, messy data from multiple sources into structured, reliable datasets ready for reporting.

Delivering dashboards on time that reduce manual reporting work and improve decision-making speed across teams. 



OBJECTIVES

•      Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards primarily in Power BI and Looker Studio, with the ability to work across other BI tools as needed.

•      Perform data transformation and cleaning (ETL) to prepare raw data from multiple sources for accurate reporting.

•      Build and maintain reliable data connections, data models, and scheduled refreshes/automations to keep dashboards current.

•      Ensure data accuracy, visual clarity, and usability across all dashboards and reports.

•      Apply data visualization best practices (layout, chart selection, color, hierarchy) to make insights easy to understand at a glance.

•      Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations teams to gather reporting requirements and translate them into functional dashboards.

•      Troubleshoot data discrepancies and dashboard errors, identifying root causes in the underlying data or logic.

•      Continuously improve existing dashboards and reporting structures as business needs evolve.

•      Document dashboard logic, data sources, and definitions so reporting remains sustainable and easy to hand off.



COMPETENCIES

•      Strong, hands-on proficiency in Power BI (DAX, data modeling, Power Query) and Looker Studio.

•      Solid experience with data transformation and data cleaning from multiple, sometimes inconsistent, data sources.

•      Working knowledge of SQL or similar query languages is a plus.

•      Strong eye for visual design and dashboard usability; able to turn complex data into simple, digestible visuals.

•      Understanding of KPI tracking, data modeling concepts, and reporting automation.

•      Familiarity with connecting BI tools to common data sources (spreadsheets, CRMs, marketing platforms, databases).

•      Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail and data accuracy.

•      Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

•      Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple dashboard projects and deadlines independently.

•      A growth mindset with a willingness to learn new tools and reporting techniques.



EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

•      1-3+ years of experience building dashboards and reports in a data, analytics, or BI role.

•      Hands-on, demonstrable experience building dashboards in both Power BI and Looker Studio (required).

•      Experience with data transformation/ETL processes; experience with SQL, Excel/Google Sheets formulas, or scripting (e.g., Python) is a plus.



EMPLOYMENT DETAILS

•      Schedule: 8-hour shift, daily (Monday-Friday).

•      Contract term: 6-month contract engagement, with possibility of extension based on performance and business need.



PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Prolonged periods of time sitting at a desk and computer.



COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY

As an equal opportunity employer committed to meeting the needs of a multigenerational and multicultural workforce, Cardone Ventures recognizes that a diverse staff, reflective of our community, is an integral and welcome part of a successful and ethical business. We hire local talent at all levels regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation or disability, and actively foster inclusion in all forms both within our company and across interactions with clients, candidates and partners.

Our ideal candidate is someone who loves building software, takes ownership of their work, and enjoys solving problems wherever they exist.



This is not a greenfield project. You'll be joining an established engineering team and jumping into a mature platform with a large existing codebase. Success in this role requires the ability to quickly understand existing systems, work within established patterns, and confidently enhance and extend applications while helping us modernize them over time.

You'll be joining a small, highly collaborative engineering team where every developer has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact. There are no layers of bureaucracy or endless meetings—just talented people working together to build products that people use every day.



You'll work on a diverse set of applications spanning consumer websites, business software, AI-powered tools, search technology, interactive product configurators, and internal business systems. No two weeks are exactly alike, and you'll have the opportunity to work with modern technologies while helping shape the future direction of our platform.



We're looking for someone who enjoys figuring things out, isn't afraid to dive into an existing codebase, and takes pride in building software the right way. description:
The Opportunity

 

We're building a client acquisition operation. Right now, we need someone who can reach prospects, start conversations, and keep the pipeline flowing so I can focus on closing and serving clients.

 

You'll be the first point of contact. Your job is to generate qualified conversations and move them toward a call. You'll spend most of your time on outreach: finding people who fit what we're looking for, crafting personalized messages, and following up to book calls. You'll track everything that happens so we know what's working.

 

As the business grows, your responsibilities will expand based on what makes sense operationally. This could mean deeper sales operations work, team management, or other areas. We'll build it together as we go.

 

This is structured work with clear metrics and a clear growth path.

 

---

 

Who We're Looking For

 

You have experience starting conversations with prospects or customers in a sales or marketing context. This could be cold outreach, prospecting, inside sales,
 campaigns, customer follow-up, or similar work. You understand how conversations move forward.

 

You're coachable and willing to learn. You don't need to be perfect at sales already. If you have a foundation and you're willing to learn, we'll develop your skills from there.

 

You're organized. You can manage multiple conversations simultaneously and follow up consistently without dropping balls.

 

You communicate clearly. You can write professional, personalized messages. You understand how to reach someone in a way that gets a response.

 

You're adaptable. You're willing to learn new systems as the role grows. You're not looking for a rigid job description that never changes.

 

You're self directed. Given a process and clear expectations, you execute without needing constant supervision.

 

You're honest. If something isn't working, you say so. If you don't understand something, you ask.

 

---

 

How We Work Together

 

We're hiring for attitude and coachability. During weeks 1 to 2, you'll learn our outreach playbook with direct founder guidance. We have daily 30 minute check-ins where you'll get feedback, answers to your questions, and direction on what to focus on each day. Your job is to execute and learn. Our job is to make sure you have everything you need to succeed. By week 3, you'll be running outreach independently with confidence.

 

We value execution and honesty. You'll work directly with a founder who communicates clearly and invests in your growth.

 

---

 

What We Offer

 

Compensation and Structure:

- Trial period (Weeks 1 to 2): $200 per month, paid weekly, flexible part time hours

- Full time (Week 3 onward): $400 per month, paid weekly, 8 AM to 5 PM Pacific, Monday through Friday

- You're paid for all work accomplished during the trial period

 

Benefits:

- Paid time off and paid sick days

- 13th month bonus annually

- Performance bonuses tied to specific wins and KPI achievement

 

How the Trial Works:

During weeks 1 and 2, we'll evaluate whether your learning speed and execution style match what we need. You'll execute our outreach playbook and hit quality and consistency metrics. If you're a fit, we move to full time immediately. Full benefits and detailed compensation policies are provided at onboarding.

 

---

 

How to Apply

 

Include the word "Iron Man" in your subject line or in the first sentence of your message. This is required. Applications without "Iron Man" will be skipped.

 

We'll review applications on a rolling basis and reach out if there's a fit.

title: Contracting and Credentialing Associate (Remote Non-US)
description:
PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR APPLICATION HERE:





Job Title: Contracting & Credentialing Associate



Location: 100% Remote (Offshore)



Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor



Compensation: $600-$900



Hours: 40 hours/week, primarily EST business hours





About Josi Health



Josi Health is a fast-growing remote healthcare company focused on making autism & ADHD diagnostic evaluations and therapy more accessible, faster, and less stressful for families. We operate across 40+ states and work with major insurance carriers. Our clinical network of Licensed Psychologists (PsyD/PhD) and Therapists (LCSWs, LPCs, LMHCs) must be flawlessly credentialed and enrolled across all major insurance carriers to ensure care delivery is fully reimbursable.





About the Role



We are seeking a highly organized, details-driven, and proactive Contracting & Credentialing Associate. In this role, you will own the end-to-end provider credentialing and payer enrollment lifecycle. You will act as the master coordinator ensuring our clinical tea
mbers are credentialed quickly and with zero gaps in coverage.





This is not a slow-paced data-entry job. You will run our credentialing pipeline like a high-efficiency production line – tracking strict timelines, managing provider data registries, executing primary source verifications, and proactively following up with payers to eliminate administrative delays. This role will also require strategic thinking – to identify how we can improve our internal processes, network access and optimization, network expansion opportunities and credentialing timelines.





Key Responsibilities



Provider Credentialing



- Manage end-to-end credentialing and re-credentialing processes for Clinical Psychologists (PsyD/PhD), therapists (LCSWs, LPCs, LMHCs) and other remote clinical providers



- Maintain and audit all provider profiles in CAQH, ensuring information is current, attested, and fully compliant



- Perform primary source verifications of provider licenses, certifications, education, and malpractice insurance history



- Maintain secure, centralized physical and digital provider credentialing files, fee schedules, and databases





Payer Enrollment & Roster Management



- Prepare, submit, and track provider enrollment applications with payers



- Compile and distribute monthly provider rosters to active insurance plans to ensure payer directories remain accurate



- Identify and resolve provider-level NPI, taxonomy, or enrollment errors that cause clearinghouse or payer-level claim rejections



- Actively track credentialing cycle times and report on application statuses across our active expansion pipeline





Contracting Support & Network Adequacy



- Monitor contracting pipelines, ensuring group contract addendums and provider agreements are executed correctly



- Support the operations team by gathering data and preparing applications to challenge commercial panel closures (network adequacy appeals)



- Regularly audit payer directories to ensure Josi Health providers are visible and active





Coordination & Compliance



- Monitor licensure and certification expiration dates (e.g., state medical licenses, DEA, malpractice) and send timely renewal alerts to providers



- Collaborate closely with recruiting and clinical teams to coordinate the onboarding schedule of incoming providers



- Adhere strictly to NCQA standards, URAC guidelines, and HIPAA regulations regarding data security and privacy



- Provide clear, professional updates to providers on their credentialing status, making document retrieval as painless as possible





What We're Looking For



Must-Have



- 2+ years of healthcare experience specializing in provider credentialing, payer enrollment, or provider relations



- Highly proficient with CAQH



- Working knowledge of medical licensing structures (e.g., PsyPact), NPI registries (NPPES), and primary source verification standards



- Obsessive attention to detail – a missed box or expired license can disrupt operations; you double-check everything



- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; comfortable reaching out to busy providers and navigating complex payer customer service lines



- Strong spreadsheet skills (Excel/Google Sheets) for tracking active pipelines and provider cohorts



- Reliable remote work setup with backup power and high-speed internet (aligned with EST hours)





Preferred



- Experience credentialing remote/telehealth providers across multiple states



- Familiarity with NCQA credentialing standards, PECOS, and various state Medicaid portals



- Experience in behavioral health networks



- Certified Provider Credentialing Specialist (CPCS) certification





What We Offer



- Fully remote – work from anywhere outside the US



- Competitive monthly compensation in USD



- Direct ownership of a vital operational pipeline in a fast-scaling startup



- Support from a collaborative, tech-forward administrative team





How to Apply



1. Upload your resume (PDF)



2. Complete the short questionnaire



3. Submit
